## Fixed
- The video player has a pause and resume control and a seek bar, and the stray half-drawn platform control strip is gone, so a video can be stopped or jumped without leaving the page
- A video that runs out now plays the next one from its related list instead of stopping on a still frame, and a queue with nothing behind it leaves the surface's Play ready to start the last video again
- The hand-off at the end of a video now behaves the way the reference does: the next video's card appears over the finished one with its name, channel, frame, a countdown ring and Cancel / Restart / Play now for as long as the delay the viewer chose, and turning autoplay off leaves the finished video where it is instead of rolling into anything
- The next video no longer starts from a cold request: the player resolves and warms the video its queue will roll into inside the reference's own 60 second lead and hands that same stream to the next page, so on device the new video reached `state=3` (playing) 0.735 s after the queue synced instead of 33.7 s

## New
- The music tab draws "Artists for you" from the artists you have actually listened to when YouTube Music does not send that shelf
- Playback settings now live on the player itself: a gear in the surface controls opens a sheet with Loop video, Autoplay next video and the autoplay delay, and the app's Settings page carries the same two autoplay controls, so the hand-off is changed where the reference changes it and the choice survives a restart
